Class Commands

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.client.Commands
final class Commands extends Object
The /swordai command. Client-side, so it needs no cheats and no operator rights.

    • demo

      private static int demo(net.fabricmc.fabric.api.client.command.v2.FabricClientCommandSource source, String kind)
      /swordai demo [kind]: the user fights the training's opponents and is recorded for the network to learn from (see DemoPlan). Training on the screen that is running is put aside and goes on by itself afterwards.

    • fov

      private static int fov(net.fabricmc.fabric.api.client.command.v2.FabricClientCommandSource source, int degrees)
      Says, or sets, the field of view of the picture the network gets. The screen stays at the configured field of view either way; a narrower picture is the middle of the frame.
      Parameters:
      degrees - 0 only reports

      private static int retry(net.fabricmc.fabric.api.client.command.v2.FabricClientCommandSource source, int number)
      Throws away what was learned from a stage onwards and trains it again, starting from the network as it was when the stage before it was passed.
      Parameters:
      number - the stage, counted from 1; 0 means the current one

    • name

      private static int name(net.fabricmc.fabric.api.client.command.v2.FabricClientCommandSource source, String nick)
      Says, or sets, the name of the fake player the AI fights. A fake player has the skin of the Minecraft account of its name, so this is also how its looks are chosen, wherever its looks are free to choose: where the AI reads the screen it has to see the blue and green figure.
      Parameters:
      nick - null only reports

    • skin

      private static int skin(net.fabricmc.fabric.api.client.command.v2.FabricClientCommandSource source, Boolean on)
      Says, or sets, whether the player is shown the opponent's own skin while the AI plays on the screen. The AI's picture stays the keyed one either way.
      Parameters:
      on - null only reports

    • undo

      private static int undo(net.fabricmc.fabric.api.client.command.v2.FabricClientCommandSource source)
      Goes back to the network as it was kept before training without the screen, or learning from people, last took over: whichever of the two began last. That copy is then used up, so a second undo goes back to the one before it.
